I've replied to Tobias in the thread: the depot was Southgate. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted in #inc-tansley-carrier-api that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note later says Southgate cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a street address for the site, and there's no Tansley account file in the share that would have one. I told him that too.
